result.rationale: totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 100 users, limit 50), this yields 3 pages though only 2 exist, and since showingLast requires currentPage == totalPages, the UI will let users navigate to an empty last page and never mark the real last page as 'showingLast'. Math.ceil(user_count/limit) would be correct. This is verifiable directly in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this returns 3 instead of 2, enabling navigation to an extra page. The `next` action can then set `offset` to `user_count` (e.g., 100), and `findMembers()` will request `offset=100`, yielding an empty members list while `currentPage` becomes 3 (`Math.floor(100/50)+1`). Using `Math.ceil(user_count/limit)` (with proper zero handling) would avoid the empty page.
